description: This file is a stylesheet (CSS) for the Bootstrap framework and its theme (Morph from Bootswatch). It defines color schemes, font settings, layout styles, and responsive behaviors for a web application's front end. It is not a source code for programming logic, but rather a style definition file.

classes.name: btn
classes.description: Base button style with positioning, border radius, background color, shadow, and transition effects. Includes variants for focus, hover, active, and disabled states, as well as outline styles and color themes (primary, secondary, success, info, warning, danger, light, dark).

classes.name: btn-group
classes.description: Container for grouping buttons with shared styles like background, shadows, and border radius. Handles hover, focus states, and grouped button border radii adjustments.

classes.name: nav-tabs
classes.description: Navigation tabs styling with background, box-shadow, border-radius, and active state effects. Manages first and last child styling for tab rounded corners.

classes.name: nav-pills
classes.description: Pill-style navigation with background, box-shadow, padding, border-radius, and active state styling.

classes.name: breadcrumb
classes.description: Breadcrumb navigation with background, shadow, and border-radius, consistent with other components.

classes.name: pagination
classes.description: Pagination component styled with consistent background, shadow, border-radius, and justified content.

classes.name: input-group
classes.description: Input field grouping with background, border radius, inner shadow, and customized form-control styles.

classes.name: form-range
classes.description: Slider input styling with inset box-shadow for track and thumb.

classes.name: form-check-input
classes.description: Custom styled checkbox/radio input with background, border, and shadow effects for focus, checked, and active states.

classes.name: form-control
classes.description: Styling for form inputs, including custom file upload buttons with shadow effects.

classes.name: form-select
classes.description: Select dropdown styling with shadow effects.

classes.name: alert
classes.description: Dividers with background color, box-shadow, and backdrop blur for alerts, with variants for different alert types (primary, secondary, success, info, warning, danger, light, dark).

classes.name: tooltip
classes.description: Styling for tooltip inner content and arrow with box-shadow and backdrop blur. Show class controls opacity.

classes.name: popover
classes.description: Styling for popover, toast, and modal content with box-shadow and backdrop blur.

classes.name: progress
classes.description: Progress bar styling with inset box-shadow (incomplete content).

classes.name: ert-light
classes.description: A custom class providing a semi-transparent background with complex inset and outset box-shadow effects for a lightweight visual overlay.

classes.name: alert-dark
classes.description: A custom class for dark-themed alert backgrounds, combining semi-transparent overlays with layered box-shadows for depth.

classes.name: badge.bg-secondary
classes.description: Badge variant with secondary background color and custom text color.

classes.name: badge.bg-light
classes.description: Badge variant with light background color and custom text color.

classes.name: tooltip.show
classes.description: Class controlling tooltip visibility, setting opacity to fully visible.

classes.name: tooltip-inner
classes.description: Inner container for tooltip content with custom box-shadow and backdrop blur for a polished appearance.

classes.name: tooltip .arrow
classes.description: Arrow element for tooltips decorated with similar shadow and blur effects.

classes.name: popover
classes.description: Container for popover content styled with layered box-shadow and backdrop blur for depth and aesthetic consistency.

classes.name: toast
classes.description: Notification toast styling similar to popovers, with layered shadows and blur effects.

classes.name: modal-content
classes.description: Modal dialog container styled to have layered shadows and backdrop blur, matching other overlay components.

classes.name: progress
classes.description: Progress container with inset box-shadow for a sense of inset depth.

classes.name: progress-bar
classes.description: Progress fill with a subtle box-shadow for emphasis.

classes.name: card
classes.description: Base card container with inset box-shadow effects to add depth and layered appearance.

classes.name: card-primary
classes.description: Card variant styled with specific inset shadows for primary-themed appearance.

classes.name: card-secondary
classes.description: Secondary variant of card with tailored inset shadows.

classes.name: card-success
classes.description: Success-themed card with inset shadows to emphasize positive status.

classes.name: card-info
classes.description: Info-themed card with inset shadows for visual distinction.

classes.name: card-warning
classes.description: Warning styled card with inset box-shadow effects.

classes.name: card-danger
classes.description: Danger-themed card with inset shadows highlighting caution or errors.

classes.name: card-light
classes.description: Light variant of card with inset box-shadow, visually softer.

classes.name: card-dark
classes.description: Dark variant of card with inset shadows to match dark themes.

classes.name: card-header
classes.description: Card header with a bottom border in rgba color for separation.

classes.name: list-group
classes.description: List group container with background color and inset shadow for depth.

classes.name: list-group-item
classes.description: List item styled with transparent background, allowing parent styles to show through.
